# Act I
Page 10
WREN: I don't want gulls. Go away!
A BOY: You are going to be sent back at the end of the week. And good riddance.
WREN: I don't know anything about it.
BOY: Is! (MUSIC IN.)
WREN: Isn't!
BOY: Round and round the lighthouse goes! (He laughs and runs off.) (MUSIC with the sound of waves as WREN is led on by MRS. HOLLOWAY and another KEEPER.)
KEEPER: She came over on the morning ferry.
(MUSIC OUT, waves continue.)
Page 11
KEEPER: She sat by the rail and said nothing. (KEEPER exits.)
MRS. HOLLOWAY: I suppose I'd better tell you where you're going.
WREN: No.
